regime_context: A broad, eligible-expansion (21 of 49 themes eligible) semiconductor-heavy leadership regime. The headline is Memory/HBM/Storage with the highest momentum score and a healthy 0.7 durability bar, but the rotation view is 'narrowing' and 'directional: false', meaning leadership is consolidating rather than cleanly rotating. Cross-sectional rank ~ rank-IC is near zero and rotation-timing has no forward edge; the only validated leg is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps: true), so a directional lean here is modest and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch whether one-narrative consolidates or breaks: if the rotation breadth (currently 0.43, 'narrowing') climbs above 0.55 while Memory/HBM/Storage slips below the AI Infrastructure score in the detector, that would mark a confirmed handoff to AI Infrastructure leadership; until then it remains a narrowing, non-directional consolidation, not a callable rotation.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity carries the cleanest trend signature (hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0, durability_bar 0.81) of the scorable themes, and unlike the headline semis it is not the most-crowded name in the top block. The trend-gate leg is the most validated risk-control signal we have, and it is fully intact here, so if the consolidating semis leadership wobbles this name screens as the more durable trend-following alternative. Crowding flag is raised (z 1.91), which per guardrails caps conviction rather than inviting a fade.
evidence: crowded=true with crowding_z=1.91 (sizing caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: A z=1.91 crowding flag is the highest in the top block, and a true trend with full breadth can still hand back gains quickly if the AI/semis leadership unwind drags the whole software-security complex with it.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its 20-day low while SMH makes a new 20-day high before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The headline theme holds the top momentum score (2.59) and a solid 0.75 breadth with the durability_bar (0.7) still intact; it is not crowded (z 0.41). This is the prevailing narrative, and the trend gate supports staying with it rather than fighting it. Lean is deliberately low because momentum rank is a focus lens, not an alpha signal, and rank-IC is near zero.
theses.dissent: The headline is a mem/commodity-storage cycle that can reverse hard on capacity/supply news; 'one_narrative=false' and 'directional=false' show the leadership is already broadening, which tires the incumbent.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its 50-day moving average while durability_bar for Memory/HBM/Storage falls below 0.5 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: A rare trend leg with the strongest durability_bar of any scorable theme (0.89) and near-full breadth (0.923), yet it is not crowded (z 0.88). It offers a non-HBM tech exposure that avoids the most extended parts of the memory tape while still passing the trend gate, which is the one validated edge we have.
theses.dissent: It is heavily XLK-weighted and will bleed with any broad mega-cap tech de-rating, even if its own constituents have stronger breadth than the equal-weight tech name.

falsifier.text: XLK underperforms XLE by 4% while the Non-AI Tech breadth drops below 0.5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
